We are looking for a skilled and motivated Systems Administrator to join our team and take ownership of the organisation's IT infrastructure. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the stability, integrity, and efficient operation of our server environments, networks, and supporting systems. The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver with a strong technical background and a commitment to delivering reliable, secure, and high-performing IT services. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage both day-to-day operations and longer-term infrastructure planning.

- Install, configure, and maintain server hardware, operating systems, software, and associated infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability
- Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve server-related hardware and software malfunctions across workstations, servers, and communication infrastructure, providing timely service support to minimise disruption
- Monitor network performance and system health on an ongoing basis, identifying potential issues and making proactive adjustments to maintain service quality and reliability
- Prepare and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including operational procedures, system logs, configuration records, and IT policies and instructions
- Assess current and future infrastructure needs by regularly surveying existing systems and recommending enhancements to server capacity, network design, and technology implementation
- Ensure computer site design and layout allows all hardware and software components to integrate and function cohesively within the broader IT environment
- Manage system security measures including user access controls, patch management, antivirus solutions, and firewall configurations to protect organisational data and assets
- Plan, implement, and test backup and disaster recovery procedures to safeguard data integrity and ensure business continuity
- Administer and support databases, virtualisation platforms, and cloud-based services as required by the organisation
- Collaborate with IT team members, vendors, and internal stakeholders to deliver infrastructure projects and resolve escalated technical issues
- Provide guidance and technical support to end users and junior IT staff, promoting best practices and ensuring effective use of systems and tools

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Proven experience in a Systems Administrator or similar IT infrastructure role
- Strong working knowledge of Windows Server and/or Linux operating systems, including installation, configuration, and maintenance
- Demonstrated experience with network administration, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, and firewall management
- Proficiency in virtualisation technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V
- Experience with backup and disaster recovery solutions and the ability to develop and test recovery procedures
- Sound understanding of IT security principles, including access management, patch management, and vulnerability remediation
- Ability to prepare clear technical documentation and maintain accurate system records
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues under pressure

- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud

- ITIL Foundation certification or experience working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework
- Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, and Microsoft 365 administration
- Knowledge of monitoring tools such as Nagios, PRTG, or SolarWinds
- Prior experience working in an enterprise or multi-site environment

We are hiring a Software Engineer who will single-handedly analyse, design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack operational systems serving Chinese clients across semiconductor, MCU, and cross-border business domains. This is not a narrowly scoped position — the successful candidate must independently manage the complete lifecycle of multiple concurrent software systems, from requirements gathering with Mandarin-speaking stakeholders through to production deployment on China-compliant infrastructure.

The role requires a rare combination of full-stack software engineering, hands-on Linux server administration, working familiarity with IC design and EDA tool environments, and the ability to operate fluently in both English and Mandarin Chinese across technical, business, and compliance contexts. The candidate will be the primary technical owner of all systems and must be capable of working without supervision across all layers of the stack and across all stages of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and document full-stack web applications end-to-end — including React or Vue front-end interfaces, Python-based backend services, relational databases, RESTful APIs, authentication systems, and administrative dashboards — within a single-engineer ownership model.
- Build and maintain internal tools, management systems, workflow dashboards, and client-facing operational platforms for cross-border Chinese SMEs, semiconductor companies, and engineering teams, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms (WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-specific cloud APIs) using Chinese-language API documentation.
- Develop and maintain software tools, scripts, and workflow automation systems that support IC design operations, including DFT workflows, Verilog-based digital logic design, verification pipelines, and EDA tool environments (Cadence and Synopsys) — covering environment configuration, licence server management, and build-flow automation.
- Deploy, configure, monitor, and maintain applications on Linux-based server environments across Mainland China and international infrastructure, including ICP-filed domains, China-based hosting, cross-border DNS and CDN configuration, reverse proxy setup (Nginx), and environment-specific application configuration. Troubleshoot infrastructure issues specific to China-facing deployments, including Great Firewall constraints and dual-environment architectures.
- Identify technology limitations, performance bottlenecks, and process gaps across existing systems, then independently design, implement, and document improvements — maintaining technical documentation, API references, deployment runbooks, and operational procedures in both English and Chinese.
- Analyse operational metrics, system performance data, user feedback, and error reports to drive continuous improvement across all systems under management.
- Serve as the primary technical point of contact for bilingual teams, Chinese clients, and stakeholders across China, Hong Kong, Singapore, and Australia, conducting requirements gathering and technical communication in both English and Mandarin Chinese.

Technical Requirements

Required

- Hands-on experience in full-stack web development, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver complete systems from front-end to backend to deployment.
- Strong proficiency in Python as a primary backend language, with production experience in Django, Flask, or FastAPI for building database-backed web applications and API services.
- Production experience developing front-end interfaces using React or Vue (not merely prototyping), including state management, component architecture, API integration, and responsive design.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining internal tools, admin panels, operational dashboards, and workflow management platforms for business users.
- Solid understanding of RESTful API design, relational database modelling (PostgreSQL or MySQL), authentication and authorisation systems, third-party API integration, and system-to-system communication patterns.
- Hands-on Linux server administration experience, including setup, configuration, application deployment, Nginx reverse proxy configuration, SSL/TLS management, firewall rules, log management, cron jobs, process supervision, and production troubleshooting — not merely development on Linux.
- Practical experience with Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipeline configuration, and cloud or hybrid server deployment environments.
- Working knowledge of digital IC design workflows, including an understanding of DFT (Design for Test) concepts, Verilog HDL, digital logic design, synthesis, and verification processes — sufficient to develop, configure, and maintain software tools and workflow integrations that support IC design engineering teams.
- Direct experience working with EDA tool environments, specifically Cadence and/or Synopsys toolchains, including at least one of: tool installation and environment configuration, licence server setup and management, build-flow scripting and automation, or integration of EDA tools into broader engineering workflow platforms.
- Familiarity with ARM Cortex and/or RISC-V processor architectures and MCU-based development workflows, with sufficient understanding to build and maintain software systems that support semiconductor engineering and production operations.
- Demonstrated experience with Mainland China infrastructure and compliance requirements, including ICP filing processes, China-based hosting configuration, China-accessible domain and DNS setup, and deployment of applications that function reliably behind the Great Firewall.
- Experience building operational software systems for Chinese businesses, including direct integration with Chinese digital platforms, services, or APIs (e.g., WeChat ecosystem, Alipay, China-based cloud providers), with the ability to independently read and implement from Chinese-language technical documentation.

Preferred

- Experience developing automation scripts, engineering workflow tools, internal development platforms, or integration layers specifically for semiconductor or IC design teams in China.
- Understanding of MCU, semiconductor, embedded systems, or IC design industries in Greater China and broader Asia, particularly where software platforms support engineering, production, or client delivery workflows.
- Experience with software performance optimisation, security hardening, monitoring and alerting systems, and deployment automation for production environments operating across multiple jurisdictions.
- Familiarity with cross-border data handling, dual-environment deployment architectures (China/international), and the operational constraints of running software services that must function in both mainland Chinese and international network environments simultaneously.
- Experience working in small teams or as a sole technical operator with full ownership of systems from requirements through to production support.

Language & Communication

- Proficient in English.
- Fluent Mandarin Chinese, both spoken and written, is required.
- Ability to communicate technical requirements, system issues, software specifications, and deployment matters with Chinese clients and Mandarin-speaking stakeholders.
- Ability to read and interpret Chinese platform documentation, API documentation, compliance materials, and technical communication; draft technical communications in Chinese for mainland stakeholders; and navigate Chinese-language developer resources, forums, and support channels without assistance.

About the role 

DekkoSecure is an international technology company with deep expertise in protecting highly sensitive and mission critical data. DekkoSecure's focus is building military-grade, end-to-end encrypted security workflow solutions for government, law enforcement agencies, defence primes, and the enterprise healthcare sector. Our product suite includes DekkoCORE, a highly secure platform for file sharing and collaboration, and DekkoDEMS, purpose-built for digital evidence management. As we scale, we are creating a dedicated Business Systems Analyst position to sit at the centre of our product, support, commercial and operations functions. 

The Business Systems Analyst is responsible for eliciting and documenting business and system requirements, analysing existing processes and data, and translating client and internal needs into clear functional specifications and improved system functionality. The role is the central reference point between platform users, the product and engineering teams, and the wider business, ensuring that changes to our systems and processes are well specified, tested and adopted. 

Key responsibilities 

We are seeking an engaging, organised and analytical individual with advanced written and verbal communication skills who can: 

 * Work with platform users, clients and internal teams to draw out what they need from DekkoSecure’s systems, pin those needs down precisely, and write them up as requirements that both the business and the engineering team can build against. 

* Engage with users and clients across the company’s Australian, Northern European and North American markets to elicit, formulate and document business and system requirements, and to analyse how the platform is used in each market. 

* Examine how work currently flows through the company’s support, onboarding and data-handling activities and build process and data maps that expose where the business loses time, drops information or breaks down. 

* Analyse client usage of the platform to identify adoption patterns, friction points and where users encounter difficulty or inefficiency, feeding these findings back to the product and engineering teams with recommendations for improvement. 

* Weigh the available options and put forward the process changes and system behaviour the business should adopt, ranking each recommendation by the value it returns and the number of users it affects. 

* Turn agreed requirements into functional specifications the product and engineering teams can build from, across both DekkoCORE and DekkoDEMS. 

* Apply data and process modelling techniques to design and document how information and processes flow across core business systems, establishing and maintaining a single source of truth. 

* Set the test plans and acceptance criteria each change has to pass and run that testing, so nothing reaches production or client use until it holds up against the agreed requirements. 

* Run analysis and implementation work as planned, costed and resourced initiatives using agile methods, including the programmes to consolidate the company’s systems and formalise its processes, and track them through to delivery. 

* Design and maintain reporting and forecasting dashboards that give leadership accurate, data-driven visibility of system and operational performance. 

* Create and maintain documentation, including internal standard operating procedures for staff and external user guides and Help Center content for clients. 

* Conduct training and structured walkthroughs of new and changed platform functionality for internal users and clients to support adoption and validate that delivered changes meet acceptance criteria. 

* Be the person the business turns to on how its systems and processes work, advising the product, support, commercial and operations teams when they need to make system or process decisions. 

Skills, qualifications, experience required 

* A relevant tertiary qualification in information technology, business informatics, or a related cross-functional business and information technology discipline. A postgraduate qualification combining information technology and business is highly regarded. 

* Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment in a client-facing role. 

* Willingness to undertake occasional international travel to Europe and North America for requirements gathering. 

* Ability to understand user and client needs and translate them into documented system and process requirements. 

* Demonstrated ability to translate user and client needs into documented system and product improvements within a software or SaaS environment. 

* Experience with CRM systems, document and collaboration platforms. 

* Competence in data and process modelling, and in producing clear system specifications and process documentation. 

* Experience preparing and delivering user training. 

* Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and non-technical teams. 



Desirable 

* Exposure to secure collaboration, document management or cybersecurity software products. 

* Familiarity with project management methodologies (for example Agile) and supporting tools. 

* Experience supporting product roadmap decisions through structured feedback and analysis. 

How to apply 

Applications must be submitted through this advertisement. Please include a current resume and a short cover letter addressing the essential skills and experience above. Applications are open to Australian citizens and permanent residents and to other candidates with valid work rights in Australia.

AC motors and motor control
